description: Smart Filter Pro by OKVIZ is a versatile filtering solution designed to enhance data exploration and reporting of Power BI. It adapts to different user needs by offering multiple filter modes, each tailored to specific scenarios—from compact drop-down selections to detailed hierarchical filtering. With Smart Filter Pro, you can streamline your dashboard, improve data accuracy, and make your reports more interactive and insightful. Key Features DropDown Mode Offers a compact drop-down list for a clean, space-efficient filtering interface. Filter Mode Enables interactive multi-select filtering, allowing for quick segmentation of data. This is the fastest way to filter data in Power BI, since it doesn't require loading all the data in the slicer, but performs the query directly on the data model. Search Mode Provides real-time search with auto-complete to help you quickly locate specific values. Observer Mode Displays filtering options in a read-only format, ideal for presentations or non-editable dashboards. Hierarchy Mode Supports multi-level, hierarchical filtering to drill down into complex data structures seamlessly. Smart Filter Pro also supports Bookmarks, Sync slicers, Incremental data loading, Copy & Paste, and advanced customization.
